record.question: Which of the following clauses is/are covered under Article 20 of the Indian Constitution? (I) .No person shall be convicted of any offence except for violation of a law in force at the time of the commission of the act charged as an offence. (II) No person shall be prosecuted and punished (of the same offence more than once. (III) No person accused of any offence shall be compelled to be a witness against himself.
